page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom; no margin notes. Handwritten ink marks at top right ("N.14." struck through) and the printed number "35" at top right are outside the printed text and are not transcribed as text; the page number 35 is printed at top right.

main_text.l: Qua exoletas hæreses illas, & complicum eorundem,
in errore eorum, qui rerum Divinarum notitiam ab
Die 6. & 13. Jan. H. L. Q. S.

page.notes: Handwritten ink annotation "N.14." struck through at top right and a dark ink spot near "Divinarum" are not printed text and are omitted. The printed page number "35" is at top right. Title lines are set in mixed roman, italic and black-letter-like capitals; the italic words "Quam", "PRÆSIDE" and the Jan. dates are rendered as printed. The two-column names block is transcribed as parallel cells.
